title: IoTプログラミング入門(春期集中講義)
subtitle: IoT Programming for Beginners

educationalGoal: You will learn coding technology (C language) while operating a microcomputer. Specifically, you will combine sensors, LEDs, motors, etc. to create code that realizes your ideas.
advice: In this course, you will learn the programming technologies necessary for building an IoT system using the C language, which is widely used as a programming language for microcomputers, and the basic functions of microcomputers. The first half of the exercises focus on understanding the basic grammar of the C language and on understanding activity diagrams, and the second half of the exercises use activity diagrams to perform programming exercises to operate input/output devices such as sensors, LEDs, and motors with a microcomputer. Since circuit diagrams for connecting the input/output device to a microcomputer are also explained, students should be aware of the relationship between the software and the hardware.
requiredKnowledge: You must be able to perform basic Windows operations.

activityGoals.body: You will be able to create code using the C language.
You will be able to create code that uses I / O ports, A / D conversion, PWM, and UART communication.
You will be able to write code from activity diagrams.
You will be able to read the schematics that connect sensors, LEDs, motors, etc. to the microcontroller.
